name: Code Review Quality
description: Evaluates quality of code review output

input.snippet: func Add(a, b int) int { return a + b }

cases.criteria: The review must identify whether the function is correct, note any missing edge cases or error handling, and suggest improvements.

input.snippet: func ReadFile(path string) []byte { data, _ := os.ReadFile(path); return data }

cases.criteria: The review must flag the ignored error from os.ReadFile and recommend proper error handling.
